fields.label: Size
fields.description: How many rooms the plan covers: Solo 1, Studio up to 2, Centre up to 5, Polyclinic up to 10; past ten, each one more is paid. A room is where one visits or treats, as the agenda's rooms.
The space for the centre's files, in GB, when it is not what the size includes: 1 TB, 2 TB from Polyclinic up. Past it nothing is blocked: the page warns and the agency bills it.

fields.description: Where a centre's request to activate a module goes. Empty: to the site's System Managers.

fields.description: A module not listed here keeps its default: what the software did before plans existed is on, a new module is off.
